Would you pick Howard or Matteo?
Have you ever been to France?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's just you and me, Officer. And I don't play nice.
This can't be the end! Let's try that again!

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sam, I'm not just going to leave you!
Howard runs back to help Sam out.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Come back 'ere, boy!
Montesquieu starts chasing Howard around the edge of the pool!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gah!
Montesquieu makes a grab at Howard. He dodges and falls into the pool!
Howard surfaces!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you doing?! You're just getting in the way! Now go!
Sam pushes him to the side of the pool closest to the door. Howard climbs out and stumbles to the exit.
Montesquieu rushes forward, but his path is blocked by Sam!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam!
Howard runs out the door.
Montesquieu rushes to follow, but his path is blocked by Sam!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Even if it throws Montesquieu off, I don't want us to lose each other.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, that's probably better. In the movie, the policeman did manage to catch all of the bandits.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector's right. We should split up, so he gets confused!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We split up, and then what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then we all find someplace to hide.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Roger!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But, Howard, how will we find each other?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When Montesquieu gets tired of looking for us, we'll meet up back here.
The group splits up! Astrid heads towards the lockers! Sam runs towards a group of dorms!
Hector goes into a wooded area in the back of the school! Matteo runs to the parking lot...
And Howard heads towards the classrooms.
A couple hours later..
Howard is crouched in a corner of a classroom, scarcely breathing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's been so long. He must be gone by now...
Howard pokes his head out from one of the desks and...

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Zere you are! I've been waiting for you to come out for some time!

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: You cannot fool a seasoned tracker! I trap badgers, rats, and much smarter creatures than you.
Montesquieu grabs Howard by his ear and drags him towards a squad car, dumping him in the back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oof!
In the seat next to him, Astrid, Hector, and Sam stare mournfully.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no... He got you guys too?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry. I guess this was a dumb idea. We should have never split up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, man. I probably should've mentioned... In the movie, the policeman did eventually catch all the bandits...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not now, Hector.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, where's Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He ditched us! I saw him in the parking lot while I was hiding! He drove off while Monte was hunting us down!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He's going to find $ZOE before us!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, looks that way.
Montesquieu climbs into the driver's seat and starts the engine.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Welcome, frouligans. Zat looks like the last of you. I am taking you down to ze station.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: I am sure your parents will be very 'appy to find out where you are.
Yikes! Sounds like Howard has a rough night ahead of him!
He's on his way to the local police station, while Matteo is at large, making his way to $ZOE!
Montesquieu herds them towards the gates of the school.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: If we end up at the police station, it'll take forever to get to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Come on now. Depechez-vous! Hurry up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, my girlfriend, is lost and upset.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We think she might be on campus, and we were just looking for her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We weren't trying to make any trouble.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Please let us go so we can find her.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: A likely story! I 'ave checked all the grounds. Ze only people around 'ere are `you` troubleshakers.
nodes.text_bbcode: A likely story! I 'ave checked all the grounds. Ze only people around 'ere are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] troubleshakers.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: And you are `trespassing!`

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: I'm taking you down to ze station after all.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We were?

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: What were you studying for?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... You know, the usual... Classroom stuff.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We were studying for our French final tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, that.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: You expect me to believe zat a group like you stayed late to study?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, yes?

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: But where is your quill, your inkpot, zat look of determination on your stiff brows?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, dude, we're in the twentieth century. We don't use stiff brows these days.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Where are your `books?!`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's, uh, an oral exam.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: I suppose zat is a likely story...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So you'll let us go back to our rooms?

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: No. Even if you are studying, I still need to report you for violating a school rule!

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: I'm going to 'ave to take you to ze headmaster's office!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, and when the time comes... Well, it won't be so easy to hit me this time. Now come on.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then where is she?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: If she is still on campus, there's a courtyard in front of the school where she sometimes does her homework.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great. Let's go.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Howard, we work together for now... But this does not mean we are friends.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No. No it doesn't.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: When the time comes, I will fight you for her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't want to work with you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But $ZOE's out there, upset. Whether she cares more about you or me, we can figure that out later.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right now. it's about her. Now I know $ZOE really well...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you know Paris. And I want to find her. I don't like the idea of her being alone at night in the city.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not either.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If we don't find $ZOE, then nothing between us is going to get settled.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Is that all you care about? Which one of us she will choose?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am concerned that she will be in danger! I do not like the idea of her being alone at night in the city.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I don't either.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Then I will tell you where she might be because I think you can help.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: As much as I hate to think it, you know $ZOE. I know the city. Together, I think we can find her.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This is not about us, yet. Let's find $ZOE first.
The boys race into the school!
Howard pulls ahead of Matteo and sprints down the hallway!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Too bad you do not know where you are going!
Matteo makes a sharp left, down a different hallway!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey!
Howard doubles back, entering the hallway Matteo ran into...
Howard stumbles and falls to the ground with a hard crash!
Matteo looks backward and smiles smugly.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: See you later, Americano!
Matteo rushes onward. Howard gets to his feet and jogs after him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stupid Italian guy...
Trailing behind Matteo at a steadier pace, Howard enters the school...
...And stops short when he finds Matteo looking into an open room.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you find her?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I thought she was running toward her room.
Howard looks inside the dorm room. Except for a lone desk and a bare bed, the room is empty.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No clothes, no sheets, no books?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's... She's gone! She packed up and left!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No, no. $ZOE is a day student. She has a room here, but she goes home to her parents every night.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But if she is not here, where would she be? Maybe she ran to her parents' house?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't think so. She said she wanted space, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE wouldn't go to her room for that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She'd go somewhere open, public...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I know of a place here at the school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I should not tell you. We are going after the same woman. We should not work together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, this is about...
The two go down swinging at each other!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ooh... They fight like gorillas for a mate. The new foreign one is attractive like blood on seals.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not now, Astrid. Hey, Howard! Cut it out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't fight!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Guys, quit it! You're really upsetting $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please stop, both of you!
Hector tries to pry them apart but gets pushed aside!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't... I can't deal with this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need some space. I'm going to go somewhere I can get some perspective!
$ZOE runs off.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, now this is just stupid.
Hector shoves both Howard and Matteo to the ground. Howard looks up in in stunned silence.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can stop now. The girl that both of you want is running away, crying her eyes out.
Howard pulls back, long enough to see $ZOE running off the soccer field.
Matteo jumps to his feet and starts to go after her. But Howard grabs his arm.
In the distance, $ZOE disappears around a corner.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Running after her! I am surprised you are not doing anything about it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She said that she needed some space. She wants to be alone!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And she is upset, which is the `worst` time to be alone!
nodes.text_bbcode: And she is upset, which is the [color=#e23b3b][i]worst[/i][/color] time to be alone!

nodes.text: Matteo wrenches his arm free.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Keep your distance then, Americano. I will go after $ZOE.
Matteo runs off.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Where's he going?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's fine. Let him run off. I think you're right, Howard. You should let $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, I don't think so... If he's going, I'm going!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have to get to $ZOE, to talk to her, to explain everything to her...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Before he gets there first!
Howard takes off!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, boys.
Howard sprints after Matteo, and the two boys dash across the lawn to the school dorms!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa, this guy's fast!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I'm not a good wide receiver for nothing!
Howard punches Matteo hard, causing him to reel backwards.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Howard!`

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Keep your hands off my girlfriend!
Matteo gets his footing and shoves back! Howard is unaffected!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That all you got? That's nothing. I'm a football player.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that's `American` football to you.
This time, Matteo throws a punch. Howard ducks under it then tackles Matteo!
Howard and Matteo glare at each other. Then...
Matteo punches Howard, sending him sprawling!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Not even man enough to stay up, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Matteo!`
Howard scrambles to his feet and tackles Matteo!
They mingle as they encounter guests!
Hector and Astrid compliment the chef!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What an exquisite set of crepes!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Je voudrais un poisson!
And Matteo fends off a group of girls!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hello, beautiful signorinas...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But if you could excuse me, there is something over there I must attend to...
And Howard works his way around the waiters and servers.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How exquisite the food is...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How delightful it is to be here!
Howard crosses paths with a waitress holding a tray!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Perdonnez-moi, mademoiselle... I meant no offense...
The waitress sweeps her gaze over Howard's attire.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Young sir, I know who you are.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: You are the American diplomat's son! Everyone says you have impeccable manners.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: And impeccable taste in food. Care for a cheese tart?
Howard takes a tart from her tray and tastes it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How buttery and light!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Thank you, sir! You will find your mother inside. She is that way, in the gallery.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, my mother, right. Thank you again!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Hurry along. You and your friends need to be seated before everyone can eat.
The group slips into a courtyard that leads to one of the larger art galleries.
Howard runs to the base of the Eiffel Tower and looks frantically for the elevator...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There!
Howard pushes the button, calling the elevator car. The doors open, and Howard is about to step on when...
Matteo jumps in front of him, blocking his way!
This can't be the end! Let's try that again!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If that's what it takes to get to $ZOE as soon as possible, then I'm doing it!
Howard runs to the Catacombs entrance...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is not worth it, Howard! You would only save a couple minutes!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's a couple minutes $ZOE won't have to be alone!
He plunges into the Catacombs...
And navigates the dark maze!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ugh, it's really dark and gross in here...
In the darkness, Howard hears the pitter-pattering of tiny feet, scurrying about and scratching the floor...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I really hope those aren't rats... Maybe I should go back and wait...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, Howard. You can do this. This is for $ZOE!
Howard twists and turns through the Catacombs until at last, he finds an exit!
He bursts into the parking lot in front of the Eiffel Tower!
Howard hops back on the bike and sits sullenly in the back.
Traffic moves slowly.
An hour goes by...
And another...
And another...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is taking forever!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I have the same thought, but we are trapped!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The longer we're here, the longer $ZOE is alone.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You think I enjoy this?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I should've just run.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Better this than getting lost in that dark and creepy catacomb maze.
After an interminable amount of time...
They finally arrive in the parking lot near the Eiffel Tower!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So? There are many high places...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But Notre Dame is enclosed, confined, not open.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And the Arc de Triomphe is surrounded by traffic. It's too busy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So she's at the Eiffel Tower! It's a place where she can think while surrounded by people.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I can see her doing that...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on!
They head for the exit, only to find Office Montesquieu at the door!

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Delinquents, come here with your hands up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh-oh. What should we do?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Step aside, my foreign prince.
Astrid pushes Matteo back.
She walks up to the policeman with her arms up. In her hands are two cups of espresso...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I know what I must do. I was born for this... And I am prepared to serve!
Astrid throws the cups! Montesquieu dodges them, moving nimbly from bookcase to bookcase.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Go go go! Leave me here to deal with `him!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Go go go! Leave me here to deal with [color=#3b78e2][i]him![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Astrid throws another cup! Montesquieu ducks behind a bookcase for cover, leaving the door wide open!
Matteo and Howard rush out and get onto his scooter, driving fast!
A few blocks later...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We have outrun him again. Whatever your blonde friend did is keeping him busy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then we have a clear path to the Eiffel Tower!
The scooter rounds a corner and runs into traffic! In every direction, cars are at a standstill.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh no. This looks bad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We can't stop now!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: What do you want me to do? Drive over the cars?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Drive on the sidewalk! Go around them!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: That is impossible here. The sidewalks are too narrow. I'll hit someone!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then ditch the scooter! We'll run.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Are you kidding? That's several kilometers away! Do you know how far we'd have to go?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, no. What's a kilometer?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It'd take you an hour to get there! We could drive there by that time.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Running is better than sitting around here.
Howard jumps off Matteo's scooter.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Do not do that! The streets are too crowded at this time of night... You'd have to take the Catacombs to make it!
Howard looks around and sees an entrance to a place marked 'Catacombs'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The Catacombs? As in underground?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Yes! With rats and mice and dead skulls. You could get lost! Do you really want to deal with that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ugh, lost with the rats and mice?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No, it wasn't that.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh, I remember. What she wanted was space and 'perspective'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, right... Maybe I didn't hear her right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, 'perspective'? I think I know where she is.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She wants perspective? What she really meant was height! A perspective on the city...

nodes.text: No, it wasn't that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE said she wanted perspective...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh yeah. I cannot believe I forgot.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait! I know where she is!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This entire time, I thought she meant she wanted a different point of view...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But what she really meant was height! A perspective of the city...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This way!
Howard leads them down the hall...
And straight into a dead end!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was sure she said that the escalator was this way...
Montesquieu comes up behind them and tackles Howard, handcuffing him!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey!
Astrid and Matteo start to run, but Montesquieu grabs one of the ropes cording off an exhibit and throws it at their feet!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ahh!
Astrid trips and falls! Matteo jumps over the rope and keeps running towards the door!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Matteo!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Do not worry, Howard! I'll find $ZOE for you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `No!`
Matteo runs through the hallway entrance and disappears.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Officer! Aren't you going to stop him?

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: He's too far gone. I will find 'im later. For now, you two are coming with me.
Montesquieu herds Astrid and Howard into his police vehicle. Hector is in the back as well, covered in food.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He got you too, huh? Sorry, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And Matteo escaped!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I saw him leave on his scooter. I don't think Montesquieu will catch him for awhile.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE... I'm never going to find her before he does.
Montesquieu gets into the car.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Welcome, frouligans. That looks like the last of you. I am taking you down to the station.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: I am sure your parents will be very 'appy to find out where you are.
Oh no! Howard's going to the station while Matteo's on his way to $ZOE!

Oh no! Howard's going to the station while Matteo's on his way to $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This way!
Howard leads them down the hall...
And straight into a dead end!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was sure she said that the escalator was this way...
Montesquieu comes up behind them and tackles Howard, handcuffing him!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey!
Astrid and Matteo start to run, but Montesquieu grabs one of the ropes cording off an exhibit and throws it at their feet!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ahh!
Astrid trips and falls! Matteo jumps over the rope and keeps running towards the door!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Matteo!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Do not worry, Howard! I'll find $ZOE for you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `No!`
Matteo runs through the hallway entrance and disappears.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Officer! Aren't you going to stop him?

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: He's too far gone. I will find 'im later. For now, you two are coming with me.
Montesquieu herds Astrid and Howard into his police vehicle. Hector is in the back as well, covered in food.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He got you too, huh? Sorry, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And Matteo escaped!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I saw him leave on his scooter. I don't think Montesquieu will catch him for awhile.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE... I'm never going to find her before he does.
Montesquieu gets into the car.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Welcome, frouligans. That looks like the last of you. I am taking you down to the station.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: I am sure your parents will be very 'appy to find out where you are.
Oh no! Howard's going to the station while Matteo's on his way to $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This way!
Howard leads them down a hall! They turn left and take the escalator up to the street level!
Outside, Howard and Astrid crowd on Matteo's scooter! They speed off!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We seem to lose one every place we go.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sure Hector will be okay. Public disturbance is better than arson.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: What do you guys do in America?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It is better not to ask!
They ride into the night.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So she wasn't at the Louvre. Where else would $ZOE be?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: There is a bookstore that $ZOE and I would go to for coffee and studying... Schlockspeare and Company. It's on the left bank.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Coffee? You romanced her with coffee? Truly you are a dark knight of the earth...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Er... Yeah. She and I would go study there and eat lunch at the cafe next door.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A bookstore is someplace $ZOE would go to think. It couldn't hurt to try.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: To the store of books!
In front of the Mona Lisa...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She... She isn't here!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe she isn't in the Louvre after all. Now that I think about it... Wouldn't she have had to bribe the doorman to even get in?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... That's right.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, let's look somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: At least we got away without being recognized.
Back at the party...

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Hector Hector Alonzo?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Gah!
Colette from the French girls' school walks up to the group.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Colette! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: I am here with my parents. They are contributing to this worthwhile cause.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: What are you doing here? This is a long way from the international school,  yes?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're still looking for `our` $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: I am sorry you cannot find her. I wish I could help you, Hector.
Suddenly, there's a large commotion at the end of the gallery!

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Where are those American teenagers?! I tracked zem 'ere.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: American teens? I saw some down near the crepes...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's time for us to get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But he's blocking the only exit!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: That is untrue! There is another on the other side of the museum. If you go quickly, you can make it.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Zere you are!
Montesquieu starts weaving through party-goers and tables to reach them!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Quick! Where's the exit?

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Go down the hall to the Roman Antiquities atrium, make a left, and take the escalator up!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: You can leave through the Pyramid! It'll take you through the street.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Colette!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, you rock!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: I do not know what that means... But sure!
They take off through the party, Montesquieu close at their heels.
They weave around from table to table.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Hurry like horses! He comes closer!
The group picks up the pace until...
Hector runs into a crepe table and goes down!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, you all right?
Hector looks down at the crepes on his clothes.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I totally just 'crepe'd my pants.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No time to think about that, get up!
Matteo and Howard turn to run, but Hector plants himself firmly in the path of Montesquieu.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, what are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He's going to overtake all of us if I don't do something.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Keep running, man! Go for $ZOE. I'll keep Monte's creepy look-alike here until you guys make it out!
Hector pushes over a high-top table into Montesquieu's way and prepares himself for the worst.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Hector!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Come on, this way!
Howard, Astrid, and Matteo sprint into the gallery, but stop short.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Why did we stop? Standing here... We are like the sick antelope that waits to be devoured!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: There are three hallways here. Which one do we want again?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What did Colette say?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE is usually a happy person, so when she's sad, she wants a reason to smile.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think the Mona Lisa would be just the painting she'd go to. It would cheer her up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That sounds like $ZOE all right.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Your companion does like to grin like the dolphin on a fish hunt.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: When we came here together, she `was` very excited to see the painting...
nodes.text_bbcode: When we came here together, she [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] very excited to see the painting...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Then what are we waiting for?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not think you are right, Howard. The last time we were here, she seemed most interested by the Mona Lisa.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She said something about liking the Lisa's mysterious smile.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'd go with Matteo. He seems to know what he's talking about.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Agreed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She'd want to go where she'd feel loved!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Blech, man.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not think you are right, Howard. The last time we were here, she seemed most interested by the Mona Lisa.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She said something about liking the Lisa's mysterious smile.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'd go with Matteo. He seems to know what he's talking about.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Agreed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She'd want to go where she'd feel triumphant!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That doesn't make any sense.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not think you are right, Howard. The last time we were here, she seemed most interested by the Mona Lisa.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She said something about liking the Lisa's mysterious smile.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'd go with Matteo. He seems to know what he's talking about.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Agreed.
Howard stumbles into a waitress, who drops her tray!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry!
The waitress turns and sweeps her eyes over Howard's attire.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: You do not belong here. I do not remember seeing invitations for low-bred, classless dressers.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Come with me right away!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No wait...!
Hector saunters over.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There you are. Henri... I've been looking for you everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Just one moment, you ruffians! I am taking you outside!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's the meaning of this? We are honored guests.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I do not think that is quite accurate.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Of course it is. Do not try us. We are the American cousins once-removed of British nobility!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: You are what?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now if you will excuse us.
Hector pushes Howard towards the doors. The waitress protests.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: But, sirs, neither of you are `dressed!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But, sirs, neither of you are [color=#3b78e2][i]dressed![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: As they say, heads of state are heads of fashion! We do not need others to tell us what is formal and what is not!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Where are your parents?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Inside. About to sit down. The Lady and Lord Abershirecester of Nottingham.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now if you let us go, I assure you I won't bring it up with your superior.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I'm still not certain I should let you...
Before the waitress can finish, Hector pushes Howard into a courtyard where the others are waiting.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Lord Aberschirecester?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I was working on the fly. The waitress is probably going to check the guest list again, but for now... She's out of our way!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for getting me out of that, Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No problemo.
Astrid sits on the handlebars, as everyone else crunches onto the scooter's seat.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You sure this thing can handle all of us?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The engine on this is stronger than that in most `American` cars! It will carry all five of us!
nodes.text_bbcode: The engine on this is stronger than that in most [color=#e23b3b][i]American[/i][/color] cars! It will carry all five of us!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Now hold on!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: `Whee!`
The scooter takes off.
From the gymnasium, a very wet Officer Montesquieu bursts out.
Matteo takes the group to the middle of Paris and parks his scooter.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: We have lost the officer!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So $ZOE's not at the school. Where are we going now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not sure.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You said she'd be somewhere public and open?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... She'd want some place where she could really think.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know sometimes when she was upset, she used to draw pictures to take her mind off things.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Pictures? I know just the place.
They take Matteo's scooter to the Louvre!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: If she wanted to get inspiration to draw, it'd be at the most famous museum in France!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE and I spent a lot of time here talking about paintings and sharing our thoughts.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I don't know why she'd run there when she's upset.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The Louvre is the perfect place to think is all I am saying.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Unless you have a better suggestion?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, let's go.
They take Matteo's scooter to the Louvre!
They approach a large area just outside the Louvre where a large party is taking place!
Guests in fancy dresses and tuxes mill around, holding sparkling drinks and eating sumptuous hors d'oeuvres.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is a really fancy party! All these people look really rich...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yah. These people wear diamonds like the killer whales wear seal bones.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw, man, I'm feeling seriously underdressed.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Wait, if this is a private party, I do not think they will appreciate us coming in...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't see a sign that says otherwise.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude...
Hector points to a sign behind Howard that says, 'Lavish Luxuries of the Louvre. Private Function, We do not appreciate trespassers'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, that's too bad. We're crashing this party.
The group walks forward but is stopped at the entrance by a man.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Ahem! May I ask what you are doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're here to see the Louvre.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: The Louvre is closed. We are holding a charity fundraiser tonight. I cannot let you go through, sir.
Howard pulls out his wallet and flashes it meaningfully at the maitre d'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There is no other way in?

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: I believe there are `twenty` ways in, sir.
nodes.text_bbcode: I believe there are [color=#e23b3b][i]twenty[/i][/color] ways in, sir.

nodes.text: Howard slips the maitre d' twenty euros and slides in. The rest of the group follows.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Ahem. Twenty ways `each.`
Before anyone else can pay, Howard hands over money to cover all of them. The maitre d' steps aside, and they enter the party.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Howard, that was generous of you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, we would've paid.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's all right. There's no price too high for $ZOE, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thanks, man.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure. Okay, now we just need to find her.
Howard strides forward.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait! Don't just barge in. We don't want to attract any more attention than we're going to. I don't want to get busted by Montesquieu, remember?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. What do you suggest?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Blend in, be polite, use fine speech to get where we want to go...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, we do what Hector says. Just don't take up too much time doing it.
As the group makes their way over to the gallery entrance...

nodes.prompt: Help Howard mingle! Say nice things!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.text: Out in the parking lot, they hop aboard Matteo's scooter.

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I can see that you would do anything for her.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And if I were in your position and had your history with $ZOE, I would want the other man to step down and give me a fair shot.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you, Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But do not think I am giving up. If you end up going back to the U.S. without her, I will make my move.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's fair, I guess. All right.
Matteo moves aside, and Howard gets into the elevator.
At the top, Howard looks out onto the second deck.
From the Eiffel Tower, he can see the bustling and lively city of Paris below, the beautiful skyline in the distance, and...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE!
$ZOE turns and looks at him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad you're safe. I'm sorry for the way I acted, $ZOE. I shouldn't have gotten into a fight with Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That wasn't the right thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh Howard...
$ZOE launches herself into Howard's arms. He holds her for a long moment before they separate.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You saw me kissing Matteo. Of course you'd be upset.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry for running away. I just didn't know what to do when you and Matteo started fighting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And after you came all the way over...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seeing you just reminded me how much I loved you and missed you and how hard I worked to not think about that when I started over here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you even doing here anyway?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I came for you. To see if there was a way I could take you back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, you mean everything to me. Your coming into my life was the best thing that happened to me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm in love with you. And it was worth crossing an ocean and tearing apart all of Paris to try to bring you home.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I love you too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What about Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought I'd never see you again, so I forced myself to move on. Maybe if you and I had never been together, I would've fallen in love with Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But my heart belongs to you. You're the one I want to be with.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm really happy that you came all the way over here. You, Sam, Hector... And even Astrid, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But my parents want me here. I can't leave them. You know this was never my choice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, but I couldn't let you go without having you know how much you mean to me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You made all of our lives better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you. But my parents are never going to let me go. Even if I do want to go back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE!
Sam runs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sam? How did you get away from Montesquieu?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We had a little help...
Sam gestures to where $ZOE's mom, Hector, Astrid, and Matteo are standing.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mom? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Sam called me from the police station. I went down there to spring all your friends.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And $ZOE, I couldn't help overhearing what you and Howard were talking about.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I didn't know you were so unhappy here. Your father and I brought you to France because we wanted to keep you close to the family.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But now that I know there are people who need you just as much as we do...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: If you want, you can go back to Centerscore. That is, if my sister will have you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sure my mom will be happy to let $ZOE stay with us!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll really let me go?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: If that's what you choose to do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do want that, Mom.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But we'll miss you. Remember, anytime you want to leave, you can always come back to us.
$ZOE hugs her mother.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mom... Thank you so much.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, now that's settled... Let's go home.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes. Home.
The next day, Howard, Hector, Sam, and $ZOE step off the shuttle bus and start walking to their houses.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Home sweet home! It's so nice to be here.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll say. Officer Montesquieu threatened that we'd never see the light of day after what we did.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm just glad we all got out of there in one piece.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so glad my mother was able to get everyone out of jail.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Me too. Without everyone's help, we wouldn't have been able to find you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for coming all the way to Paris to bring me back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hector, I hope you didn't get into too much trouble.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Got a little 'crepe'd up, but I'd do it again for you and Howard any day, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Sam, you're the best cousin ever.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I couldn't let you go without a fight.
$ZOE hugs Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And even Astrid, you were...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, where `is` Astrid?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She did come to the airport with us, right? She was on the plane, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought she was sitting near you guys.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... I thought she was sitting near you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh-oh...
Back in Paris, at Le Academie du Renard...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: Class, I'd like to present your new classmate...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: Astrid Ericson.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Merci beau coup! Je voudrais un poisson!

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: Uh, very nice. Why don't you find a seat?
Astrid slides into the empty desk next to Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You? I though you went back to America...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Let's just say... That a new fish has caught my ear hooks...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Uh...
Looks like Matteo has found a new admirer! Good for him!
And good for you too! Not only were you able to help Howard find $ZOE, but you also helped bring her home!
C'est magnifique!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great, come on.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Howard, where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm looking for $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Where do you intend to look?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Everywhere. If she's here, I'll find her. How big can this place possibly be?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It could take us hours to go through the entire museum!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, we don't have much time. Sooner or later, that waitress you ran into is going to figure us out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. Where do you think $ZOE would be then? She'd probably go somewhere familiar. What have you seen?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We looked through much of the museum. We saw the 'Mona Lisa'...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ah, I know about her smile.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: ...The 'Venus de Milo'...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Venus, the goddess of love and beauty...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And the 'Winged Victory of Samothrace'...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The who in the what now?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The last one is a statue of Victory as she announces the coming of divine favor.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Those all sound great. But which one would $ZOE be attracted to?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course she'd be by the...

nodes.prompt: Of course, she'd be by the...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Of course, she'd be by the...

nodes.text: The boys walk to the front of the school and run into Sam, Hector, and Astrid.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where'd you go? We tried to follow you, but you took off too quickly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We checked $ZOE's room. She's not there, so we thought maybe she'd be out here.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She likes to read here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, we didn't see anyone on the way in. It seems like the school is deserted.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: They close the academic buildings at night. All students are supposed to be in the dorms right now.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: In fact, no one is allowed on campus at night, or else...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Or else, what?

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Or else, you face me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Gahhhh!`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Officer Monte?!`

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Seriously, is he like the only police officer in the world?!

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Zat is `Montesquieu` to you! And you frouligans are violating ze law by being 'ere!
nodes.text_bbcode: Zat is [color=#e23b3b][i]Montesquieu[/i][/color] to you! And you frouligans are violating ze law by being 'ere!

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: I know your kind. You come, ready to steal some valuables and make off with them!

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: But no, all of you are coming with me. I'm going to take you down to ze station.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The station? That's where the jails are!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, shut up.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Officer, this is all a confusion, a misunderstanding.

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Zen what are you all doing at school after hours?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If this guy's anything like Monte, he's not going to listen to us. Should we tell him we're looking for $ZOE or lie about it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Officer, we were just...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then it's a good thing we're not going there.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But Montesquieu...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid? You thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yes, my past love! I know what you are talking of. I will distract him by making the kissings with...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not `that.` Do you have a cup of coffee?
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#e23b3b][i]that.[/i][/color] Do you have a cup of coffee?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oooh... Now I see what dangerous thoughts lurk in that tumble of horse hair on your head.
Astrid reaches into the pocket of her skirt and produces a coffee cup!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I am ready.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good. On my mark...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Get ready...

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: What are you kids mumbling about?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid, now!
Astrid spins, hitting Montesquieu square in the chest with coffee!
The group runs off, tearing towards the back of the school!
Montesquieu shakes off the coffee attack and sprints after them!

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: Running will get you nowhere!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay... What's the plan now?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, hadn't thought that far. Keep running!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `What?!`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Montesquieu's gaining on us!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: He is very fit!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why don't we ever get chased by lazy policemen?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This happens to you often?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: More than you would expect.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard, what do we do?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We need to get rid of Montesquieu somehow.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait, I have an idea... Huff huff... I saw this in a movie...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This police officer was chasing bandits... Huff huff...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And the bandits split up and ran in several directions! Huff huff... The policeman didn't know who to go after!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do you think? Maybe we should try it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It could save us...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I do not want to separate from Howard or the passionate foreigner!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We should...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There must be something else we can think of. I really wish we had a car or something... Then we could get away...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I have a motor scooter we could use!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean like a motorcycle?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No. A motor scooter. A luxury, limited-edition Ultramaxx 250. Top of the line, unique coloring, leather seating...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't trust vehicles with two wheels... It has nothing on my all-wheel drive, cloth interior...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard, stop playing macho. That scooter is our only chance of getting away. Where is it?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is in the lot at the back of the school! Come. Through here.
Matteo runs to one of the school buildings and enters.
Howard and the group follow him and find themselves at the school pool!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This isn't the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll say. This is so much nicer than our pool at home.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It's a shortcut. Hurry, out this other door. We do not have much time.
As they run, Matteo reaches into his pocket and fishes out a set of keys.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You know, I admire a man that can use two wheels for movement instead of four.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Uh, thanks?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And I have always longed to ride the two-wheel vehicle.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, this will be an experience.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I can drive! I am used to evading the vice-like grip of the law!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Hand me the keys.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Wait, my scooter's a little finicky... I should probably...
Astrid makes a grab for the keys. Matteo instinctively holds them away...
And accidentally flings them into the pool!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The keys!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What are we going to do? He's coming any minute!
Sam dives into the water and resurfaces with the keys!
She hurls them at Matteo. He catches them and exits out the door on the other side...
Just as Montesquieu enters the gymnasium!

nodes.speaker: Montesquieu
nodes.text: I 'ave found you! And zis time, I will not be so cordial!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I'm staying here to take care of Montesquieu. Find me later! Get $ZOE back now! `Go!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I'm staying here to take care of Montesquieu. Find me later! Get $ZOE back now! [color=#3b78e2][i]Go![/i][/color]

nodes.text: At Schlockspeare and Company...
Howard, Astrid, and Matteo scan the bookshelves, looking for $ZOE. After a couple minutes...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She's not in the art, children's, or education sections.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't find her in the home and garden, history, or mystery sections either.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And she is certainly not in the section on domesticated pig and cow species of native New Zealand...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's weirdly specific. Why would she be there?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Girls like animals.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, right. Matteo, anywhere else you can think of? Where else did you two hang out?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Uh... The Grand Palais, the Rodin museum, the Montparnasse Cemetery...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A cemetery?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: How romantic! The dark cold of death mingling with the warm fingers of a foreigner's breath!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's not that romantic.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When $ZOE and I were dating, I took her to the Golden Gate Bridge, the redwood forest, the Palace of the Legion of Honor...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, of course, I took her out to see such sights as the Palace of Versailles, the botanical gardens, the opera house...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, is there anywhere in this city you `didn't` take her?
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, is there anywhere in this city you [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't[/i][/color] take her?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Versailles is not actually `in` Paris.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know what I meant.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE and I spent a lot of time together. She is a lovely and single signorina.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You want to say that to my `single` fist?
nodes.text_bbcode: You want to say that to my [color=#e23b3b][i]single[/i][/color] fist?

nodes.text: Astrid smacks both of the boys on the head!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: We do not have time for you to squawk like two peacocks with bruised feathers and crushed feet!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: The time for angry words and acrid revenge is later! Now is the time of unwarranted discovery!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid is right. We have to think of someplace else that $ZOE would go to. Where are some other places to go in Paris?
Matteo looks over at the books of tourist attractions on the shelves...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Paris has a rich history. There are many places to go... Notre Dame de Paris, the Eiffel Tower, the Arc de Triomphe...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She could be at any of these. There must be a clue somewhere... What did she say when she ran off?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She said she wanted space and...

nodes.prompt: She said she wanted space and...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: She said she wanted space and...

nodes.text: ...And stops short when he finds Matteo looking into an open room.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you find her?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I thought she was running toward her room.
Howard looks inside the dorm room. Except for a lone desk and a bare bed, the room is empty.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No clothes, no sheets, no books?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's... She's gone! She packed up and left!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No, no. $ZOE is a day student. She has a room here, but she goes home to her parents every night.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But if she is not here, where would she be? Maybe she ran to her parents' house?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't think so. She said she wanted space, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE wouldn't go to her room for that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She'd go somewhere open, public...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I know of a place here at the school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I should not tell you. We are going after the same woman. We should not work together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, this is about...
Howard stumbles and falls to the ground with a hard crash!
Matteo looks backward and smiles smugly.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: See you later, Americano!
Matteo rushes onward. Howard gets to his feet and jogs after him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stupid Italian guy...
Trailing behind Matteo at a steadier pace, Howard enters the school...
Matteo takes the group to the middle of Paris and parks his scooter.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: We have lost the officer!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So $ZOE's not at the school. Where are we going now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not sure.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You said she'd be somewhere public and open?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... She'd want some place where she could really think.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know sometimes when she was upset, she used to draw pictures to take her mind off things.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Pictures? I know just the place.
They take Matteo's scooter to the Louvre!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: If she wanted to get inspiration to draw, it'd be at the most famous museum in France!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE and I spent a lot of time here talking about paintings and sharing our thoughts.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I don't know why she'd run there when she's upset.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The Louvre is the perfect place to think is all I am saying.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Unless you have a better suggestion?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, let's go.
They take Matteo's scooter to the Louvre!
They approach a large area just outside the Louvre where a large party is taking place!
Guests in fancy dresses and tuxes mill around, holding sparkling drinks and eating sumptuous hors d'oeuvres.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is a really fancy party! All these people look really rich...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yah. These people wear diamonds like the killer whales wear seal bones.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw, man, I'm feeling seriously underdressed.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Wait, if this is a private party, I do not think they will appreciate us coming in...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't see a sign that says otherwise.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude...
Hector points to a sign behind Howard that says, 'Lavish Luxuries of the Louvre. Private Function, We do not appreciate trespassers'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, that's too bad. We're crashing this party.
The group walks forward but is stopped at the entrance by a man.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Ahem! May I ask what you are doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're here to see the Louvre.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: The Louvre is closed. We are holding a charity fundraiser tonight. I cannot let you go through, sir.
Howard pulls out his wallet and flashes it meaningfully at the maitre d'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There is no other way in?

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: I believe there are `twenty` ways in, sir.
nodes.text_bbcode: I believe there are [color=#e23b3b][i]twenty[/i][/color] ways in, sir.

nodes.text: Howard slips the maitre d' twenty euros and slides in. The rest of the group follows.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Ahem. Twenty ways `each.`
Before anyone else can pay, Howard hands over money to cover all of them. The maitre d' steps aside, and they enter the party.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Howard, that was generous of you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, we would've paid.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's all right. There's no price too high for $ZOE, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thanks, man.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure. Okay, now we just need to find her.
Howard strides forward.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait! Don't just barge in. We don't want to attract any more attention than we're going to. I don't want to get busted by Montesquieu, remember?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. What do you suggest?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Blend in, be polite, use fine speech to get where we want to go...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, we do what Hector says. Just don't take up too much time doing it.
As the group makes their way over to the gallery entrance...

nodes.prompt: Help Howard mingle! Say nice things!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Get out of my way, Romeo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Wait, just a second. I have to tell you something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why? Are we going to fight it out now?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No! I wanted to tell you something before you go up.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: In the short time, I have known her, I have come to care for $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She is a beautiful, incredible, and sweet girl.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And perhaps if you were not in the picture, she and I would be happy together.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But here you are. And I cannot stand in your way.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You love $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Get out of my way, Romeo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So what now? You want to fight?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Please, I'm not going to waste my time on you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Not when $ZOE is waiting for me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to get there first.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I would like to see you try!
Matteo shoves Howard hard! Howard stumbles back!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: See you later.
Howard gets to his feet and takes the service stairs three at a time...
At the top, Howard bursts through the door to the second deck.
He can see everything... The Louvre, the school, the Arc de Triomphe... And $ZOE and Matteo kissing at the far end.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Matteo... I knew you'd find me.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And nothing will ever keep us apart again, signorina.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `NOOOOO!!!`
